title: AARO sends ODNI a false MFR

tellings.quote: When I went to ODNI September 10th of 2025, Kloski was director per ODNI digs

plain: A man named Dylan Borland says that sometime between 2023 and 2025, AARO, the Pentagon office that looks into UFO reports, sent a false memorandum for record, a formal written note of a meeting, to the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, which oversees US spy agencies. He says that when he went to that office on September 10, 2025, a man named Jon Kosloski was listed as AARO's director. He tells it as a sign that the UFO office misled other officials.
